name: Sink or Swim
source:
Life is going great. Day in and out Jack finds himself content with the way he's living. Or so, he likes to believe he is. 

Follow Jack as one fateful encounter at a beach tosses a stone in the shaky waters of his life and see how Jack handles the situation.

Will he take a leap of faith? Or will he stick to what he's used to?

[From [url=https://bluestuffeh.itch.io/sink-or-swim]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
生活进展顺利。日复一日，杰克发现自己对自己的生活方式很满意。或者说，他愿意相信自己是这样的。

跟随杰克，在海滩上发生一次致命的遭遇，将一块石头扔进他生活的摇摇欲坠的水中，看看杰克如何处理这种情况。

他会做出信仰的飞跃吗？还是他会坚持自己习惯的做法？

[来自[url=https://bluestuffeh.itch.io/sink-or-swim]Itch.io[/url]]
